summary: Lilholt promotes human and AI co-intelligence, argues that censoring AI does not bring safety and warns about AI-enabled bioweapons and job losses.

statements.quote: As AI scales the heights of knowledge, the safety net must be woven below.
Censoring AI doesn’t end in safety. It ends in systems that second-guess you by default.
AI-owned debt can make humans owe machines after machines eliminate their jobs.
A civilization that mixes AI and bioweapons is not preparing for victory. It is preparing its own obituary.
Co-intelligence changes how we think, not just how we compute.
